data.heading: 1. Rabi Season harvest and Summer Season Sowing Status:
data.text:
-  As on May 08, 2026, the area sown under summer crops is 83.08 lakh ha as compared to 80.01 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.  Of this, area of 31.05 lakh ha has been sown under Rice this year.
-  As on 08.05.2026, 96.36% of area has been harvested for Rabi crops all over India. 100% area of Pulses has been completed; 99.87% area of Oilseeds majorly in Rapeseed & Mustard (100%); 98.02% area of Shri Anna cum Coarse Cereals majorly in Jowar (99.66%), 65.70% area of Rice and 98.00% area of Wheat has been harvested for rabi crops 2025-26.

data.heading: Week 1 (08  May - 14 May 2026):
data.text:
-  Gradual rise in maximum temperatures by 3-4°C likely over Northwest India till 10th May and no significant change during 11th -13th May.
-  No significant change in maximum temperatures likely over Central India till 08th May and a gradual rise by 2-4°C thereafter.

data.heading: Details of each Segment
data.text:
-  Gradual  rise  in  maximum  temperatures  by  3-5°C  likely  over  Northeast  India  till  08th  and  no significant change during 10th -13th May.
-  Heat  wave  conditions  likely  to  prevail  in  isolated  pockets  over  Gujarat  state  and  West  Rajasthan during 09th -13th, 2026.

data.heading: Week 2 (15  May - 21 May 2026):
data.text:
-  Low Probability of Heatwave conditions likely during some days of week 2 over Rajasthan, Gujarat, Vidarbha, Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh. Appreciably above normal (+3.1 to +5.0°C) maximum temperatures are likely over parts of Rajasthan & adjoining Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat; above normal (+1.6 to +3.0°C) temperatures are likely along the northwest, central & adjoining eastern parts of the country. Near-normal maximum temperatures are likely across rest of the country during the week.
-  No warm night conditions are likely during the week.

data.heading: Rabi Crops - Area coverage
data.text:
-  Rice : About 31.05 lakh ha area coverage under Summer Rice has been reported as compared to 32.42 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Pulses : About 24.97 lakh ha area coverage has been reported compared to 23.76 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Oilseeds : About 11.04 lakh ha area coverage has been reported compared to 9.58 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
